Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:177550
Court No. - 75
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 35104 of 2024
Applicant :- Imran Khan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Shyam Sunder Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the entire record.

2. The present second bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in Case Crime No. 88 of 2020, under Section 376 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act and Sections 3(2)(V) SC/ST Act, Police Station Kishunpur, District Fatehpur, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
The first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 05.03.2024 for want of prosecution.
3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The alleged incident has been shown of 28.06.2020 but first information report was lodged after about 13 days on 11.07.2020.

In the first information report, it Imran Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63039813/
1 was alleged that applicant had made an attempt to commit rape upon victim and first information report was registered under Sections 354(ka), 506 IPC, Section 7/8 POCSO Act and Section 3(1)
(Da), 3(1)(Dha), 3(2) (Va) SC/ST Act and there was no allegation of rape in the first information report.

entities.text: Imran Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The victim has not made any allegation of rape in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C.
and she has stated that the applicant had only tried to remove her underwear and when she raised alarm he ran away.

The version of rape has been developed for the first time in statement of victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., wherein she has made allegations of rape but her version is not supported by medical evidence.
In medical examination report of victim, the hymen has been shown intact and no injury at all has been shown on the body of the victim.
Though, the age of victim is stated about 7-8 years but absolutely no injury has been shown on the body of the victim and there is no sign of rape.

Learned counsel has referred case of Beerbal Vs. State of U.P. and 3 others (Criminal Appeal No.3465 of 2022), decided on 02.09.2024, wherein the appellant was convicted under Section 376 IPC and Section 7/8 POCSO Act and he was granted bail mainly on the ground that the victim has not sustained any injury.

entities.text: Beerbal Vs. State of U.P. and 3 others (Criminal Appeal No.3465 of 2022)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: During trial, the victim had passed away and thus, she cannot be examined in evidence and in the absence of her evidence, the conviction of applicant is not possible.

It was stated that the applicant is in jail since 16.07.2020 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than four years but during trial no witness has been examined so far and thus, trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
It was stated that in case the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in the trial.

4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the victim is minor girl aged about 7-8 years but the aforesaid factual position, including the fact that the victim has not sustained any injury, is not disputed.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations and all attending facts, particularly the fact that the applicant has already undergone detention of more than four years, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.

Hence,
the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant, Imran Khan involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 12.11.2024 RKM  Imran Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63039813/
